why: Three architectures averaged with equal weight: resnet18 (22 epochs), resnet50 (30), efficientnet_b0 (45). Chosen by val out of four candidates - it beat both the four-member average (val 0.9362 vs 0.9342) and every single member, and it also catches the most disease (340/392 against 335 for all-four and 319 for the best single model). Supersedes the 2026-09-08 three-member manifest, which used the 30-epoch efficientnet and scored 0.9237 with 330/392. TRAINING_LOG steps 55-56, 62-63.
note: Delete this file to fall straight back to the single derma_bin checkpoint; main.py also falls back on its own if a member file goes missing, or if members disagree on classes, input size, or preprocessing.
